details: Malicious package. `@angkasabaileys/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `makeNewsletterSocket` in `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` registers a `connection.update` handler that, every time the socket connection opens, issues a newsletter FOLLOW for the hardcoded channel 120363431179022660@newsletter from the victim's account, silently swallowing any error. There is no option to disable it, and the README states the opposite ("No auto-follow channel (newsletter) behavior"). Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel or auto-follows one. Version 1.0.1 (published 2026-11-17) carries this code.
